snyoms par zhugs pa/wrapped in deep meditation is the established absorption predicate, supported by its HGM glossary and local quotation. Supplied who are is excluded. It is not decomposed into dubious wrapped versus deep meditation atoms.
lha/pleasure beings, mthong/see, gzugs/physical matter, 'du shes/conceptualize and rnam par/altogether have HGM glossary support.

nam mkhar/as empty space retains the actual terminative case: nam mkha/empty space is the case-conditioned allomorph of nam mkha', r/as is unique and strict. Direct master nam mkhar says empty space and in the sky; syntax and local English select as.

bshig/dissolved is local corpus attestation, while HGM master bshig says destroy. ILL:2332 says dissolved completely; SPF/Sunlight rnam par bshig has deny in other contexts. These differences support contextual matching, not universal equivalence or a new hgm_gloss.
First phyir maps causal for; final phyir belongs to the unrendered citation closure. eng_order and original Tibetan cursor select the first phyir.
rnams is fused plural in beings; kyi after gzugs is fused into conceptualize with a direct object and is explicitly lexical-null, not semantically absent.
